## Current objective
Continue Ledgerly SQLAlchemy 2 modernization and service-layer cleanup. Router splitting is superseded; release 2.8.0 remains a separate ordered procedure.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Billing schema: `billing_v1`. Models now use `DeclarativeBase`; timestamps use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Billing receives an injected `session`. SQLAlchemy 2 engine omits `echo=True`.
